skill.summary: Identifies up to 3 high-ROI opportunities, selects the best, executes lean plans, predicts outcomes, and continuously learns to maximize profit efficiently.

latestVersion.changelog:
To get even better skills follow me on x @SaasKafle

ProfitCore X 1.0.0 — First release

- Introduces an autonomous profit maximization loop with strict rules for identifying and evaluating up to 3 opportunities per cycle.
- Features a detailed ROI-based scoring system and mandates selection of only the highest-value opportunity (or taking no action).
- Adds step-by-step, lean execution plans with required outcome projections.
- Implements mandatory post-action learning, continuous strategy updating, and a compounding rule for repeatable success.
- Enforces high standards for intelligence, decision quality, and entrepreneurial thinking throughout the workflow.
